desc: Introducing the OA 2311 Pro Elite – meticulously engineered to deliver blistering-fast cycle times and unparalleled control during sustained firing. Perfect for duty use and high-round count range days, this full-metal pistol is built to deliver maximum reliability and exceed all expectations. Crafted from precision CNC-machined 7075 aluminum, the Elite grip module has been painstakingly refined by our team of combat veterans and competition shooters for superior ergonomics and handling when split-seconds matter. With aggressive texturing and interchangeable thumb ledges (additional options coming soon), the Pro Elite ensures a rock-solid grip purchase for peak performance and control in all conditions. Featuring a cut & contoured slide, V-ported 5″ barrel, enhanced Pro-tuned trigger, extended mag release paddle, and five mags. Fully ambidextrous controls and included optic plates make for an adaptable setup for any shooting scenario.
